content.thinking: The scrape.yaml lives in this repo and gets applied with the chart, so it's self-contained—though the platform still needs to sync/apply it, which counts as a deploy rather than a code change elsewhere.

input.explanation: The fix doesn't depend on anything outside this repository. According to its own header, the ServiceMonitor in deploy/scrape.yaml is kept in this repository and the platform applies it along with the shop's chart. Changing `port: metrics` to `port: http-metrics` there makes it match `metrics.portName` in deploy/values-production.yaml, and that is the only change needed for samples to start arriving again. The only other step is the normal sync of this repository's deploy files, which isn't a code change anywhere else. The new test is also contained in this repository, since it reads only those two files.
